name: Vampire - Spider Climb - Successes
description: Flavor text for successes a feature

results.text: The vampire ascends silently, talons clicking against stone like a macabre metronome in the dead of night.
With effortless grace, he clings to the ceiling, crimson cloak billowing beneath as if suspended by unseen threads.
Defying all natural laws, the undead horror crawls upward, leaving only echoes of his passage behind.
The vampire's ascent is swift and soundless, his form blending into the darkness above like a specter reclaiming its domain.
With preternatural agility, he scales the wall, claws carving faint grooves where mortal hands would slip.
